dashboard.subtitle: Watch every training video, then pass a short quiz to start working with clients.

quiz.title: Qualification quiz
quiz.lockedBody: Watch at least 90% of every video to unlock the quiz.
quiz.availableBody: You've completed the training. Take the quiz when you're ready.
quiz.exhaustedBody: You've used all your quiz attempts. Our training team will contact you about next steps.

course.notFound: This course could not be found.

video.title: Training video
video.completeHint: Watch at least 90% of the video for it to count as completed.
video.simulatedNote: Simulated player — playback runs at 10× speed for the demo.
video.notFound: This video could not be found.

intro.title: Before you start
intro.subtitle: Read these instructions carefully. Once you start, the timer begins.

rules.single: Each question has one correct answer.
rules.autosave: Your answers save automatically as you go.
rules.timer: The timer runs on our servers and keeps running if you leave the quiz.
rules.noPause: Closing or leaving the app does not pause the timer.
rules.switching: Please stay in the quiz until you submit. Switching apps or tabs is discouraged.
rules.timeout: When time runs out, your attempt is submitted automatically.
rules.attempts: Each started attempt counts toward your limit.

intro.resumeNote: You have an attempt in progress. The timer is still running.

quiz.title: Quiz
quiz.confirmUnanswered: You have {{count}} unanswered questions. Unanswered questions are marked incorrect.
quiz.confirmAllAnswered: All questions are answered. You can't change your answers after submitting.

result.passedBody: Congratulations — you passed the qualification quiz.
result.failedBody: You didn't reach the pass mark. Review the training and try again when you're ready.
result.exhaustedBody: You've used all of your quiz attempts. Thank you for completing the training — our training team will contact you about the next steps.
result.noAnswersNote: For fairness, correct answers aren't shown.

qualified.title: Welcome to the team
qualified.body: You've completed every step. Your Maskan workspace is ready.
